meta.title: Items selected on different pages of the PR list are all counted

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions screen as the starting point for the PR selection flow.
Ensure the test operates on open PRs, where assignment is available.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions list, select PR-1 on page 1, navigate to page 2, select PR-2, click the Assign button next to Upload PRs, and verify that the Search a user list represents both selected PRs together rather than only the current page, matching the no-common-user behavior

steps.note: Perform the cross-page selection and inspect the combined assignment-user list, which no dedicated catalog step can express.
Assert that the assignment dialog opened with the expected user-search control.
